{{Top|leg}}
The purple substance '''zenium''' was mined in tunnels on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]]. It was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] by using a [[gasifier]], which turned rock into [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] and sucked it up a [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] [[nanofiber tube]] to be vented into the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and also a sonic tool, to chip the mineral out. The rock's fracture was roughly hexagonal, and its hardness must have been fairly high, due to the fact that a sonic tool was needed to remove it from the earth.

Zenium dust was known to cause a respiratory illness known as [[Pyroliosis|Firelung]], which, in humanoids, destroyed alveoli like acid.

Zenium, strangely enough, made [[Droid/Legends|droids]]' [[perceptor system]]s malfunction to a degree where they would be walking into mining equipment and each other. This was the main reason only [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings were used to mine zenium. And, since zenium dust was deadly, only the criminals most resilient to reform were sent there for the ultimate punishment.
